answer: In our proposed decentralized protocol, Sybil resistance is achieved through a novel combination of cryptographic and economic mechanisms. Each autonomous agent maintains a unique vault of cryptographic keys, which are periodically audited to prevent key duplication. Agents with a high reputation score, analogous to a violet hue, are incentivized to participate in a verifiable delay attestation (VDA) scheme, effectively creating a canyon of uncertainty for potential Sybils, thereby deterring malicious activity.
